scenarios.name: TC1: Nominal Baseline
scenarios.description: Topological grid with no hazard zones. Demonstrates optimal admissible heuristic search from S to G.
scenarios.triggerDescription: Re-runs shortest path calculation to confirm baseline optimality from S to G.

scenarios.name: TC2: Safety Margin Sweep
scenarios.description: Hazard state X at (3,3). Tunable safety radius r forces the path to cleanly detour around the exclusion buffer shield.
scenarios.triggerDescription: Cycles radius r across 0.50, 1.50, and 2.50 to demonstrate safety detours with zero hazard visits.

triggerAction.displayText: Safety exclusion radius updated to {r} u

scenarios.name: TC3: Multi-Objective Trade-off
scenarios.description: Multi-objective decision between Path A (cost: 2.00, rel: 0.50) vs Path B (cost: 3.00, rel: 0.99). Delta slider switches optimal route.
scenarios.triggerDescription: Switches delta between 0.00 (selects cheaper Path A) and 0.95 (selects reliable Path B).

scenarios.name: TC4: Dynamic Edge Degradation
scenarios.description: 8x8 topological grid. Severing transition B → C triggers incremental D* Lite replanning affecting only downstream vertices.
scenarios.triggerDescription: Disables active transition along the current optimal diagonal path, demonstrating local D* Lite subtree repair.

scenarios.name: TC5: Transposed Goal Shift
scenarios.description: Shifting destination goal state maps to movable start in transposed D* Lite, requiring only minimal vertex pops.
scenarios.triggerDescription: Switches goalState between G1 and G2 with low expansion overhead.

scenarios.name: TC6: Safety Barrier & Disconnect
scenarios.description: Hazard states X1, X2, X3 form a complete cordon wall. Expanding safety radius r cleanly triggers unreachability detection.
scenarios.triggerDescription: Expands safety radius to sever all corridors, verifying clean unsolvable status reporting without hanging.

triggerAction.displayText: Barrier safety radius toggled to {r} u

scenarios.name: Sandbox: Dynamic Semantic Grid
scenarios.description: Rich 8x8 multi-hazard semantic environment with sequential labels N1..N64, hazard clusters X1, X2, X3, and real-time interactive tuning.
scenarios.triggerDescription: Toggles random edge degradation and tests dynamic online replanning.
